tools.name: search
tools.description: Search AIML Rounds lessons by keywords or an interview question. Filter by track (fundamentals, ai-engineering, system-design, papers), type (concept, interview, design, paper) or section/part name. Returns lesson ids for get_lesson.

tools.name: browse
tools.description: Browse the site's table of contents. No arguments: the 4 tracks with their parts and sections. With track: every section and lesson in it (optionally narrowed by part).

tools.name: get_lesson
tools.description: Read one lesson as Markdown: the interview situation, intuition, how it works (with equations in TeX), in practice, and the model interview answer with follow-ups. Use an id from search (e.g. 'ai-engineering/prefill-vs-decode'), a page URL or a title. Use tab to read one part only.

tools.name: roadmap
tools.description: The study roadmap for a role (AI Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist): topics in order, core vs useful, each with its lessons and quiz. No role: list the roles.

tools.name: quiz
tools.description: Multiple-choice questions for a roadmap topic (e.g. 'Linear algebra', 'RAG', 'Inference and serving'). Answers stay hidden unless reveal_answers is true: ask the learner first, then call again with reveal_answers to grade and explain. No topic: list topics.

tools.name: mock_interview
tools.description: Mock interview rounds per role, with model answers and what the interviewer listens for. No round: list the role's rounds. Keep include_answers false while the learner is answering; set it true to give feedback.

tools.name: jobs
tools.description: AI/ML job postings in India from the last 7 days (100+ companies, refreshed daily), newest first, with direct apply links to the company's careers page. tools.name: whats_new
tools.description: Lessons, designs, quizzes and mock rounds added to the site recently, newest first.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "browse" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
